topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: A center-to-border spacing of λ (moderate spacing) appears to provide a good balance between minimizing dB loss and maintaining beamforming flexibility. This spacing range allows for robustness against individual element failures while still maintaining a high level of beamforming precision.
reference_context: A defocused reflector concept is introduced, which is more robust against feed element failures but has a slightly reduced gain. The performance of this concept is demonstrated in point-to-point communications adopting MIMO (multiple input multiple output) principles. A model for the digital feed array is presented, and the received signals are digitized and combined in the DBF unit.
